ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels as base with 35% low-intensity dark-grey/black pixel coverage across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive lattice of low-intensity linear streaks and irregular dark-grey contiguous blobs distributed across the entire visible surface; highest density of dark pixels observed at the central peduncle attachment point and radiating outward.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a measured sharp interior angle; significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge of both lobes; more pronounced and jagged towards the outer tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary lobe surface tapering into acute, slightly upturned tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, circular pixel clusters consistent with parasite or barnacle attachment sites concentrated near the distal margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense and complex network of multi-directional, high-contrast dark-grey linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing both lobes; multiple sets of parallel scars suggest repeated surface trauma.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme density of rake marks across the entire fluke surface; irregular, blunted morphology on the far left terminal tip compared to the right.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive cross-hatch pattern of dark linear scars on the light-pigmented background surface.
